lang.item.narutorpg.baryon_mode.lore: Baryon Mode is a unique transformation accessible to Kurama with its jinchūriki.
lang.item.narutorpg.chomei_seal.lore: Chōmei, more commonly known as the Seven-Tails, is one of the nine tailed beasts. Becoming its jinchūriki grants the chakra cloak.
lang.item.narutorpg.clone_link_awakening.lore: Yanaru possesses a unique Kekkei Genkai, allowing him to mentally exchange information with his shadow clones, just as clones are able to transmit information to the main body.
lang.item.narutorpg.cursed_seal_of_earth.lore: The Cursed Seal of Earth is one of the strongest of Orochimaru's cursed seals, the other being its counterpart: the Cursed Seal of Heaven.
lang.item.narutorpg.cursed_seal_of_heaven.lor: The Cursed Seal of Heaven is one of the strongest of Orochimaru's cursed seals, the other being its counterpart, the Cursed Seal of Earth.
lang.item.narutorpg.dragon_life_awakening.lor: This unnamed kekkei genkai apparently allows the user to perform Reincarnation Ninjutsu as it allowed Ryūzetsu to perform the Dragon Life Reincarnation technique.
lang.item.narutorpg.eternal_mangekyo.lore: The Mangekyō Sharingan is an advanced form of the Sharingan that has only been activated by a handful of Uchiha when enduring a traumatic enough experience.
lang.item.narutorpg.gyuki_seal.lore: Gyūki, more commonly known as the Eight-Tails, is one of the nine tailed beasts. Becoming its jinchūriki grants the chakra cloak.
lang.item.narutorpg.isobu_seal.lore: Isobu, more commonly known as the Three-Tails, is one of the nine tailed beasts. Becoming its jinchūriki grants the chakra cloak.
lang.item.narutorpg.kama_seal.lore: Kāma is a seal that serves as a compressed backup of an Ōtsutsuki clan member's biological data that they can embed in the body of a compatible recipient known as a vessel.
lang.item.narutorpg.kokuo_seal.lore: Kokuō, more commonly known as the Five-Tails, is one of the nine tailed beasts. Becoming its jinchūriki grants the chakra cloak.
lang.item.narutorpg.kurama_clan_illusion_awak: A rare trait of the Kurama Clan.
lang.item.narutorpg.kurama_seal.lore: Kurama, more commonly known as the Nine-Tails, is one of the nine tailed beasts. Becoming its jinchūriki grants the chakra cloak.
lang.item.narutorpg.matatabi_seal.lore: Matatabi, more commonly known as the Two-Tails, is one of the nine tailed beasts. Becoming its jinchūriki grants the chakra cloak.
lang.item.narutorpg.molecular_fusion_awakenin: Sakon and Ukon's unnamed kekkei genkai gives them the unique ability to break their bodies down to a molecular level.
lang.item.narutorpg.ranmaru_eye.lore: Ranmaru uniquely possessed a dōjutsu kekkei genkai which, when activated, causes his eyes to glow red in colour.
lang.item.narutorpg.rinha_absorption_awakenin: The kekkei genkai of the Rinha clan allows them to absorb a person's chakra and duplicate their appearance and memories.
lang.item.narutorpg.rinne_sharingan_eye.lore: The Rinne Sharingan is a dōjutsu kekkei mōra and the predecessor to the Rinnegan and Sharingan.
lang.item.narutorpg.sage_scroll.lore: Sage Mode is an empowered state that can be entered by blending natural energy with one's chakra, creating senjutsu chakra.
lang.item.narutorpg.sage_transformation_awake: The kekkei genkai of Jūgo's clan is an instinctual ability which allows its members to absorb and make use of natural energy without any training in senjutsu.
lang.item.narutorpg.saiken_seal.lore: Saiken, more commonly known as the Six-Tails, is one of the nine tailed beasts. Becoming its jinchūriki grants the chakra cloak.
lang.item.narutorpg.shikotsumyaku_awakening.l: Shikotsumyaku is a kekkei genkai which gives its wielder the ability to manipulate their own bones.
lang.item.narutorpg.shukaku_seal.lore: Shukaku, more commonly known as the One-Tail, is one of the nine tailed beasts. Becoming its jinchūriki grants the chakra cloak.
lang.item.narutorpg.smoke_body_awakening.lore: This unique kekkei genkai is possessed by the members of the Iburi clan, which allows them to turn their bodies, either partially or fully, into smoke to serve various purposes.
lang.item.narutorpg.son_goku_seal.lore: Seiten Taisei Son Gokū, more commonly known as Son Gokū or simply the Four-Tails, is one of the nine tailed beasts. Becoming its jinchūriki grants the chakra cloak.
lang.item.narutorpg.susanoo_scroll.lore: Susanoo is the strongest ability available to those who have awakened the Mangekyō Sharingan in both eyes, having been passed down through the Uchiha Clan's generations.
lang.item.narutorpg.ten_tails_seal.lore: This Ten-Tails is the Tailed Beast incarnation of the God Tree previously cultivated by Isshiki Ōtsutsuki and Kaguya Ōtsutsuki; the latter having eaten its chakra fruit and later merged with the God Tree in a battle agai
lang.item.narutorpg.tenseigan_chakra.lore: The Tenseigan Chakra Mode is a heightened transformation unique to those who possess the Tenseigan.
